milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the orange concrete cluster (centered at spawn-relative [4.5, 0.5, 3.5]) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target' without requiring them to stand on top of it.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted orange_wool ends up in the player's inventory. No orange_wool exists in the scene initially (not in chest, not in player inventory), so having 1+ confirms successful crafting.
Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden_axe ends up in the player's inventory. No wooden_axe exists in the scene initially, so having 1+ confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because when a jungle_fence_gate block is mined, it drops as an item that enters the player's inventory. No jungle_fence_gate items exist in any inventory initially, so having 1+ confirms the player successfully mined one of the placed fence gates.
